关键词: Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series G
主要内容: The Royal Bank of Canada filed a Form 6-K on January 8, 2016, which includes legal opinions and a consent related to the issuance of its Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series G, denominated in U.S. dollars. The filing is pursuant to the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-208507). The report includes two legal opinions: one from Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP regarding Canadian, Ontario, and Québec law, and another from Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the Notes under New York law. Additionally, a consent from Morrison & Foerster LLP as special tax counsel for the Bank is included. The filing is part of the registration statement and is deemed incorporated by reference as an exhibit to the registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-208507). The report was signed by authorized officers of the Royal Bank of Canada on January 8, 2016.
